subject.description: A matte-black Minecraft-native armored hovercraft with four tall hover pods, yellow stabilizers, twin front rails, faceted cockpit glazing, bilateral cargo doors, rear fins, and a functional six-seat interior.
subject.intended_runtime: Minecraft Java Edition 1.20.1 through the Immersive Aircraft Blockbench model loader
subject.seat_layout: two cockpit seats plus four forward-facing rear seats in two rows
uncertainties: The supplied Meshy GLB has no modeled interior, so the two-plus-four seat cabin is inferred from the exterior volume.
The underside is partially hidden in the source and is reconstructed conservatively as a layered armored keel.
Small alphanumeric decals are simplified into readable Minecraft pixel glyphs.
The data-pack skin scales the authored model to the previous Militech skin's 13.6-block length and supplies matching final world-space seats and hitboxes.
